hint: tap anywhere to throw the party

game.q: small dark house. one coin gone. what does she do?

wrong.nine: nine is not ten. she is not settling.
wrong.robot: no robot vacuums back then. just a broom and pure grit.

game.right: YES. she burned precious lamp oil and swept every corner until it turned up.

end.line: a woman swept her whole house for one coin, then called the neighbors to celebrate.

cliff.s2: it’s buried in someone else’s field. what he does next makes the neighbors stare.

share: one coin. one broom. one very loud party. a story Jesus told, on infinite hill
